case_resolved_lead_verified.subject: Premium analytics dashboard stops refreshing every afternoon
case_resolved_lead_verified.body: Since we moved to the Premium plan, our analytics dashboard stops refreshing QuickBooks data every afternoon between 2 and 5 pm and shows 'request failed' on most widgets. Mornings are fine. About 40 people use the dashboard. What is going on?
case_resolved_lead_verified.analysis: The support lead (LEAD-CASE-261106-6C7E3C) provides the definitive root cause and two possible solutions: upgrade to Diamond membership or keep Premium and adjust QuickBooks refresh settings (shared cache, 15‑min interval) and optionally request higher RPS quota. Two lead‑verified cases (CASE-261106-0B0F83, CASE-261105-78DB6D) confirm the shared‑cache workaround. No conflict exists; the lead’s upgrade recommendation overrides any other suggestions. Therefore the reply combines the lead’s primary fix and the alternative older approach, citing the lead case and one verified case.
case_resolved_lead_verified.resolution:
Hi, I see your Premium analytics dashboard is hitting the QuickBooks request‑per‑second limit during the 2‑5 pm peak, causing the widgets to fail.

Please choose one of the following solutions:

1. **Upgrade to Diamond membership** – this raises the RPS quota and eliminates the throttling.
2. **Keep your current plan and apply the older workaround**:
   a. Open **Dashboard Settings → Data Sources → QuickBooks**.
   b. Change **Refresh mode** to **Shared cache**.
   c. Set the **Refresh interval** to **15 minutes**.
   d. If you still need live‑data updates, have your account admin request an increased QuickBooks RPS quota from the Integrations team.

After implementing either option, monitor the dashboard during the afternoon window. If the issue persists, let us know.

Thanks for your patience.

evidence.subject: Support-lead diagnosis for CASE-261106-6C7E3C
evidence.resolution:
Root cause (support lead): Premium dashboards refresh every widget for every viewer once a minute. With ~40 concurrent users in the afternoon peak, the QuickBooks connector exceeds its requests-per-second (RPS) limit and the integration throttles the requests.
Verified solution (support lead): upgrading you account type to diamond member ship will resolve this issue. i you wish not to upgrade the system then the same older approach works
